development_status: All original 300 and previous 537 SciFact claims are exploratory.
candidate_screen: Union of within-claim top five under full rationale, full product, isolated rationale, and arithmetic full/isolated weights 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 in each pool. This preserves every eligible candidate for each of these six controls.
new_context: For each screened sentence, use the document title and the target sentence plus its immediate preceding and following sentences. Retain the original order and use the target sentence rationale output.
smoke: First 32 source groups in a fixed hash ordering; infer all screened candidates. Require finite outputs, correct target index, exact budgets, unchanged control admissions, and a useful precision signal before full inference.
development: Four source-grouped folds, equal training weight per claim and candidate pool. Compare raw contexts, arithmetic fusion, constrained dual-context calibration and constrained three-context calibration. Tune only on development data.
new_information_control: Local-only score and fixed three-score blends receive the same screened candidates as learned fusion.
stopping: If the local-context smoke has no useful precision signal, stop full local inference. No external test outcomes are used for adjustment.
